name: SRL-2018 Remote Desktop Server RD-01 — Memory Forensics
description: Volatility3 memory analysis. 12 LOTL processes + code injection in 12 processes. Second most heavily compromised RD server after RD-04. 12 LOTL processes indicates active C2 beaconing at time of memory acquisition.

artifacts.description: vol3 windows.pslist LOLBAS: 12 living-off-the-land processes detected simultaneously. Multiple cmd.exe, powershell.exe, rundll32.exe instances. Windows 10 Enterprise, acquisition 2018-09-07.

forensic_anomalies: 12 simultaneous LOTL processes exceeds any legitimate administrative baseline — typical admin sessions spawn 1-2 at most
Multiple concurrent LOTL instances is the signature of C2 framework (Cobalt Strike/Empire) maintaining multiple beacons or lateral movement threads
LOTL count (12) matches injection count exactly — each LOLBAS process is a shellcode container

artifacts.description: vol3 windows.malfind: code injection in 12 processes (PIDs include: ee, 00, 8128, 30, 6036 and others). PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE regions detected — classic shellcode memory protection signature.

forensic_anomalies: Exact correlation between LOTL count (12) and injection count (12) — each LOLBAS binary is hollowed/injected, consistent with reflective DLL injection or process hollowing
PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE in non-JIT processes is anomalous — legitimate Windows processes do not allocate +RWX memory outside JIT compilers
Same injection pattern as RD-03 (7), RD-04 (33), RD-05 (43), RD-06 (4), WKSTN-04 (24) — identical attacker toolset deployed across all compromised hosts
